row:
Are you looking for a reliable source of health information? We aim to make informative videos & funny shorts to help make learning fun.🤩 If you are looking for natural remedies for any aliment, & we do not already have a video it, let us know! 
Dr. McCoy creates videos on sport injury prevention, how to stretch away joint pain, and how to strengthen weakened muscles. You do not have to be a professional athlete to take advantage of his specialized skills. 💪
Dr. Mandi focuses on the stages of pregnancy, pregnancy health tips, pediatric milestones & care. 🤰🏼
Dr. Karin has 24 years of experiences & creates a variety of videos on several topics.
All of our chiropractors here are more than neck, back and joint pain specialists. We help people obtain more than pain relief, but optimal wellness.
Before you try any of our health tips, check with your healthcare provider to confirm it is appropriate for you specific condition, hopefully that is one of us here at Drummond Chiropractic.
